dossier.title: Prototype Destruction
briefing: A military prototype, the Constrictor, has been stolen and is loose in your sector. {PATRON} broadcasts from {HERE} with standing orders: the vessel must be destroyed before hostile forces can analyze its systems. Accept this contract to receive coordinates for the target.

Once you have destroyed the Constrictor, proceed to any station to report the kill. You will be given further orders and tasked with the delivery of recovered intelligence. The Navy expects swift completion.

hunt.success: Target destroyed at {TARGET}. Proceeding to station report.

report.arrive: Report to any station for orders at {TARGET}.
report.fail: Failed to report at {TARGET}. Mission aborted.

dossier.lead: {PATRON} broadcasts a priority target contract from {WORLD}.

rumour.far: Rumors from {WORLD} indicate {PATRON} has posted a contract for destroying stolen military hardware.
rumour.near: {PATRON} broadcasts from {WORLD} that a rogue prototype hull poses a direct security threat.

dossier.news: {PATRON} is recruiting contractors at {WORLD} for a priority military operation.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander accepted a Navy contract to eliminate a stolen prototype hull.

closing.complete: On day {DAY}, the Constrictor was destroyed and its intelligence delivered to {WORLD}, fulfilling the Navy contract.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, operations failed at {WORLD} and the Navy contract was abandoned.
